description: This file defines utility functions for handling Spark SQL V2 tables, including schema validation, metadata extraction, and name qualification within the Spark SQL connector catalog.

methods.name: toQualifiedName
methods.description: Constructs a qualified name string for a catalog and identifier.

methods.name: validateCapturedColumns
methods.description: Validates that the captured data columns match the current table schema based on the specified validation mode.

methods.name: validateCapturedMetadataColumns
methods.description: Validates that the captured metadata columns are consistent with the current table metadata.

methods.name: extractMetadataColumns
methods.description: Extracts metadata columns from a DataSourceV2Relation.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters metadata columns by a list of column names, normalizing names for comparison.

methods.name: metadataColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata columns from a table if supported.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes column names based on case sensitivity setting.

methods.name: resolver
methods.description: Provides the schema resolver from configuration.
